partial_notes.reprocess: replays buffered lidar/imu groups through the normal loop; repaired clouds are substituted by header stamp within 1 ms of the group end; p_imu internal preintegration/deskew state is not checkpointed

notes: time cursors are part of the checkpoint; imu/deskew caches are not

snapshot_refused_after_host_reset: until the host publishes odometry again
